uv: a multi line array without a trailing comma gets one added to the old last item.
-- changes --
[{"name":"urllib3","ecosystem":"pypi","to":"2.2.2","method":"override","file":"pyproject.toml"}]
-- in:pyproject.toml --
[project]
name = "app"

[tool.uv]
override-dependencies = [
  "idna==3.7"
]
-- out:pyproject.toml --
[project]
name = "app"

[tool.uv]
override-dependencies = [
  "idna==3.7",
  "urllib3==2.2.2"
]
